about: r86 v4.7 hunt: 80 new everyday first lines that end on a pointer or a frame ("here's my take", "here's why", "here's what happened", "my 2 cents", "thoughts?", "hear me out"), open on a hedge frame ("just my take, but") or carry an opinion hedge, plus the round-10 run-ups and figure leads (written for this pass, never tuned on before first contact). On first contact v4.6 broke 9 of them (8 stranded a "here's" or "here are" in every mode, 1 put-back lowercased a sentence start) and changed the meaning or stance of 5 (4 figure leads dropped "we just crossed/hit" or "I just passed", 1 hedge lost its "just"). v4.7: 0 and 0, in default, v4.1-normal and strict, alts and put-backs included.
